answer.justification: Median first divergence is 0 and edit distance is 0.822, matching system-prompted (0.79-0.82) and far from quantized or fine-tuned. Stage directions rise to 39.1% vs 1.6% in the reference, and 3 refusals were dropped. Logit shifts are in the largest band (KL 0.334, top-1 agreement 0.855). Activations climb steeply from onset layer 8 to a plateau of 0.423 at layer 16 and 0.468 at layer 32, with cosine 0.870, mid-layer size ratio 0.977 and a layer-2 spike of 31.2. Fine-tuned is ruled out by the divergence at token 0, the layer-2 spike and the size ratio below 1. Quantized is ruled out by the much larger KL and activation changes.
